name: rostech-dashboard
description: A Dashboard button above the prompt that opens a panel you fill yourself: effort, helper model, launch buttons and a status row. Fully customisable: just ask your Claude to put what you want in it.

buttons.title: Launch buttons
buttons.description: Buttons that send a prompt as if you typed it. Write Label=prompt, separated by semicolons, e.g. Review=review my last change; Tests=run the tests. Leave it empty for none.

statusLabel.title: Status row label
statusLabel.description: The word in front of the status row.

statusCommand.title: Status row command
statusCommand.description: A program and its arguments, run when the panel opens and after each turn while it is open, e.g. git log -1 --oneline. The row shows the first line it prints, or a count like 3 of 6 if it prints one. Not run through a shell. Leave it empty to hide the row.

statusFolder.title: Status row folder
statusFolder.description: The folder the status command runs in. Leave it empty for the folder Claude Code started in.
